about: home.db at version 22 as the releases of numbered steps built it (meta steps 22): every object's CREATE statement as SQLite stores it, in the order it made them, columns added by ALTER spliced where SQLite put them. Schema.version reads such a file by its meta.steps row; the tests check expected(22) against these and build an old-scheme file from them.

objects.name: versions
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE versions (
  id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,   -- 'sha256:' + hex of the uncompressed text
  text       ANY NOT NULL,       -- canonical JSON {"content":…,"key":…,"kind":…} as TEXT; a zstd BLOB when over 4 KB
  kind       TEXT NOT NULL,
  key        TEXT NOT NULL,
  start_ms   INTEGER,
  end_ms     INTEGER,
  offset_min INTEGER,
  precision  TEXT
) STRICT

objects.name: statements
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE statements (
  seq        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  source     TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind       TEXT NOT NULL,
  key        TEXT NOT NULL,
  version    TEXT NOT NULL,      -- a version id, or 'gone'
  stated_ms  INTEGER NOT NULL,
  run        INTEGER NOT NULL,
  device     TEXT,
  locator    TEXT,
  origin     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin IN ('source', 'repair')),
  late       INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (late IN (0, 1))
) STRICT

objects.sql: CREATE INDEX statements_record ON statements(kind, key, source, stated_ms)

objects.sql: CREATE INDEX statements_source ON statements(source, kind, seq)

objects.sql: CREATE INDEX statements_run ON statements(run)

objects.name: heads
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE heads (
  source    TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind      TEXT NOT NULL,
  key       TEXT NOT NULL,
  version   TEXT NOT NULL,         -- a version id, or 'gone'
  stated_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,      -- the newest time the source stated this version, restatements included
  since_ms  INTEGER NOT NULL,      -- the oldest statement in the unbroken run of this version
  start_ms  INTEGER,
  end_ms    INTEGER,
  PRIMARY KEY (source, kind, key)
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID

objects.name: heads_time
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX heads_time ON heads(source, kind, start_ms) WHERE version <> 'gone'

objects.name: rereads

CREATE TABLE rereads (
  seq    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  source TEXT,
  kind   TEXT,
  key    TEXT,
  family TEXT,
  unit   TEXT,
  CHECK ((source IS NOT NULL AND kind IS NOT NULL AND key IS NOT NULL AND family IS NULL AND unit IS NULL)
      OR (source IS NULL AND kind IS NULL AND key IS NULL AND family IS NOT NULL AND unit IS NOT NULL))
) STRICT

objects.name: cursors

objects.name: grants
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE grants (
  id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  family     TEXT NOT NULL,
  from_ms    INTEGER,             -- the first civil day's start; NULL: no lower bound
  to_ms      INTEGER,             -- the day after the last's start; NULL: open, so new asks fall in as they come
  unit       TEXT,                -- one extract only; from_ms and to_ms then bracket its end
  newest     INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (newest IN (0, 1)),               -- 1 newest first, 0 oldest first
  measure    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (measure IN ('calls', 'usd')),        -- what per_day and total count
  per_day    REAL,                -- NULL: no daily limit (only a bounded grant)
  total      REAL,                -- NULL: no total
  rank       INTEGER NOT NULL,    -- lower goes first
  state      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('active', 'paused', 'cancelled')),
  reason     TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  changed_ms INTEGER NOT NULL
) STRICT

objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE enrichments (
  family      TEXT NOT NULL,
  item        TEXT NOT NULL,
  prompt      TEXT NOT NULL,
  input_hash  TEXT NOT NULL,
  reply_key   TEXT,
  reused_from TEXT,
  content     TEXT NOT NULL,      -- canonical JSON; 'null' while pending
  state       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'done', 'refused', 'given-up')),
  unit        TEXT,               -- unread, with at_ms, started and model: an ask's plan is the `asks` row (step 21)

objects.name: enrichments_insert
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER enrichments_insert AFTER INSERT ON enrichments BEGIN
  INSERT INTO dirty_days (day) SELECT d.day FROM extract_items i JOIN extract_days d ON d.family = i.family AND d.unit = i.unit
    WHERE i.family = new.family AND i.item = new.item ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET marks = marks + 1, error = NULL;
END

objects.name: enrichments_update
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER enrichments_update AFTER UPDATE ON enrichments BEGIN
  INSERT INTO dirty_days (day) SELECT d.day FROM extract_items i JOIN extract_days d ON d.family = i.family AND d.unit = i.unit
    WHERE i.family = new.family AND i.item = new.item ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET marks = marks + 1, error = NULL;
END

objects.name: enrichments_delete
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER enrichments_delete AFTER DELETE ON enrichments BEGIN
  INSERT INTO dirty_days (day) SELECT d.day FROM extract_items i JOIN extract_days d ON d.family = i.family AND d.unit = i.unit
    WHERE i.family = old.family AND i.item = old.item ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET marks = marks + 1, error = NULL;
  INSERT INTO dirty_units (family, unit, end_ms) SELECT e.family, e.unit, e.end_ms FROM extract_items i
    JOIN extracts e ON e.family = i.family AND e.unit = i.unit WHERE i.family = old.family AND i.item = old.item
    ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET end_ms = excluded.end_ms, marks = marks + 1, error = NULL;
END
